props.caption: Thailand plans controls on chemicals used in Myanmar rare-earth mining and processing.
Panama, the Marshall Islands and Norway objected to the COP31 package.
IG Metall called more than 23,000 northern workers to 24-hour action.

lead.what: Thailand is preparing to ban the export and transit of chemicals used in rare-earth mining and processing.

rest.what: Panama, the Marshall Islands and Norway objected to the COP31 package.

lead.what: Bitcoin traded at $60,192.07 after recovering above $60,000 from an early low of $55,130.
